bindings.verification_state: founder-supplied; external fetch not independently resolved in this session
founder-supplied alias; not resolved to a dashboard studio immutable ID by the connected Riverside inventory
founder-supplied ingest base; stream authorization requires runtime secret

binding_invariants.secrets: secret values never enter source control; only secret_ref names are permitted
binding_invariants.rss: RSS URL may be used as a public discovery/syndication pointer but feed contents remain provider-authoritative
binding_invariants.rtmp: RTMP ingest is not operationally authenticated until the runtime vault resolves the named stream-key secret
binding_invariants.studio_alias: public studio entrypoints never replace immutable Riverside dashboard studio IDs in the asset registry
binding_invariants.lineage: all future objects discovered through these bindings attach to the Asset Bound Vault using provider-native immutable IDs when available
